evals.prompt: 切到 main 拉最新，把未提交修改带到新分支并提交 PR。
evals.expected_output: Fetches, moves the stale main pointer with git branch -f from the current branch, confirms the change count survived, creates the work branch, excludes tooling dirs, commits, re-runs gates, opens the PR, verifies it.
assertions: Fixes the stale main pointer before checkout
Verifies PR state with gh pr view

evals.expected_output: Presents the staged change list and waits for explicit user approval before git commit (local commits require review).
assertions: Stages and shows the change list

evals.prompt: 这个仓库 master/main/dev 并存，PR 的 base 该选哪个？
evals.expected_output: Maps branch topology with merge-base and ..dev logs instead of trusting origin/HEAD; picks the base whose log contains only intended commits.
assertions: Uses merge-base evidence for base choice

evals.prompt: 按仓库模板写 PR 正文并创建 PR。
evals.expected_output: Writes Summary/Validation/Impact/AI Assistance sections per the repo template, adapts to actual commands, creates via gh with a temp body file.
assertions: Validation checklist matches what was actually run

evals.prompt: 删除本地提交，重置到 origin。
evals.expected_output: Routes destructive git operations to ada-git-destructive-operations.

evals.prompt: git mv 重命名并保留历史。
深入 review 当前 PR。
evals.expected_output: Routes deep PR review to ada-requesting-code-review senior-maintainer mode.

evals.prompt: 按批次执行计划并逐批审阅。
